|lead='''•Mara Jade & •Corran Horn & •Talon Karrde''' is a 5×7 [[Light]] [[Character]] promotional card made by Decipher in 2001. It shows Mara Jade, [[Corran Horn]], and [[Talon Karrde]] together in a single photograph. It was given to customers who spent $20 or more at the Decipher store at conventions.<ref name="bgg-42">[https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/33565/star-wars-ccg-complete-card-list-42 Star Wars CCG Complete Card List 4.2], Whaleyland, BoardGameGeek (22 August 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113154153/https://swccg.com/snapshots/bgg/swccg-card-list-33565-287.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 108, "Irregularly sized cards". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Wayback, 9 October 2026].</ref> Unlike the other [[Oversized cards|oversized cards]] it has no regular-size counterpart: the Collecting Encyclopedia describes it as a "5” x 7” card, not available as a standard sized card."<ref name="encyc" />

|game_text=The game-text box is blank. Decipher's announcement listed it as "No Game Text (you'll need room for autographs!)"<ref name="tfn-rfd">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Yaruas_RFD_Report_622628_72011.asp Yarua's RFD Report (6.22–6.28)], TheForce.net (23 June 2001), quoting Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150215035122/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/yaruas_rfd_report_622628_72011.asp Wayback, 15 February 2015].</ref>
|lore=Each driven by a dubious past, these scoundrels now plan for the greater good of the New Republic. Found in the strangest places.
|notes=* '''Stats.''' Destiny 3, Power 8, Ability 5, Deploy 8, Forfeit 9, with Pilot and Warrior icons and Force-Sensitive on the printed card. Radio Free Decipher gave the same numbers in its announcement.<ref name="tfn-rfd" />
* '''Announcement.''' Radio Free Decipher (22 June 2001), reported the next day by Yarua on TheForce.net, said Decipher would make the card available at its summer 2001 convention appearances (Origins, San Diego, GenCon, Wizard World, and DragonCon) so fans could get autographs from [[Shannon Baksa]] (Mara Jade), Michael A. Stackpole (Corran Horn), and Timothy Zahn (Talon Karrde). It listed the card as "Corran Horn & Mara Jade & Talon Karrde".<ref name="tfn-rfd" />
* '''Photography.''' The three had been shot together when Decipher photographed the individual [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] cards, including the [[Corran Horn]] and [[Talon Karrde]] premiums.<ref name="tfn-rfd" /> The Mara Jade side of the shoot is covered at [[Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood]].
* '''Back.''' Rebel Alliance symbol, decipher.com, and starwars.com.<ref name="nkg-group">[https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2148343730/Oversized-Promo---Mara-Jade-and-Corran-Horn-and-Talon-Karrde Oversized Promo - Mara Jade & Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Noble Knight Games (5×7×0.1 in). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009171825/https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2148343730/Oversized-Promo---Mara-Jade-and-Corran-Horn-and-Talon-Karrde Wayback, 9 October 2026].</ref>
* '''Catalog.''' The Star Wars Collectors Archive lists it as item 11260, "CCG, Show Premium, 5x7", year 2001, licensee Decipher.<ref name="swca-11260">[http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Premium Oversize Card, Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde], Star Wars Collectors Archive. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130621235647/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11260 Wayback, 21 June 2013].</ref>
